name: Ookami Game Another
source:
An alternate telling of the original Wolf Game story. It was created due to the number of fans that wanted to see The Wolf Game with different characters as the Wolves and Sheep.

[From [url=https://wolf-game.fandom.com/wiki/Wolf_Game_Another]Wolf Game Wiki[/url]]
translation:
对原版《恶狼游戏》故事的另一种演绎。许多粉丝想看看由不同角色担任“狼”与“羊”的《恶狼游戏》，本作便由此诞生。

[摘自[url=https://wolf-game.fandom.com/wiki/Wolf_Game_Another]Wolf Game Wiki[/url]]
